LIVE
July 2, 2026 at 9:50am ET
Stock Market Today: Dow jumps 400 points, S&P 500 and Nasdaq open higher as jobs data eases rate worries
Dow heads for 20th record close of year after jobs growth was less than expected in June, and ahead of the long Independence Day holiday weekend. The U.S. bond market closes early today at 2 p.m. Eastern.
